body.description: a Noonrider, a raider who rides the daylight for Halogen: a full-body cold-rig cooling suit of white quilted fabric and tubing, a mirrored sun visor over the face, a silver heat cape, a toll-mark tag on the chest, a long cattle prod, menacing and faceless. a person of a small South Texas border town generations after the sky turned white, sun-faded patched clothes, dust on the boots
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
